sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – 1.4404 bar from 2027-01-01: three conditional packages for authorized review
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for your letter proposing a price basis with an AS-14404 adjustment clause. We recognise that alloy prices have been volatile, and we are prepared to discuss a defined clause rather than a fixed price only.

At our annual review, your key account manager explained that price changes above 2 % need the approval of your pricing committee (doc:20260812-70740-M3). So that we do not lose time, please submit the complete packages below to the authorized pricing decision-maker now. We are not asking for a meeting or a call.

Your sales director has also told us that Werdenfels will focus on customers with volume (doc:20260916-70740-M5). We are offering a 24-month commitment covering our full need of 23,700 kg per year, DAP, 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01, with no tooling.

We propose three alternative packages, each for 24 months. They are approximately equivalent for us after rounding:

A: EUR 5.18 per kg, payment 90 days net, no index clause.
B: EUR 5.13 per kg, payment 90 days net, index clause AS-14404, material share 45 %, 5 % deadband, base month 2026-08.
C: EUR 4.94 per kg, payment 14 days net, index clause AS-14404, material share 45 %, 0 % deadband, base month 2026-08.

Each price, payment term and clause is one indivisible conditional package. Faster payment or a narrower deadband applies only with that package price.

Which complete package can the authorized pricing decision-maker approve, or which priced term prevents approval?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract with an AS-14404 index clause and 14-day payment terms. To fully consider your projected volume of 23,700 kg per year, please provide the corresponding historical consumption data. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Based on this package, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 5.60 per kg. Specifically, our offer includes a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Part 370010 – 36-month conditional packages for authorized approval
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer at EUR 5.60 per kg for 24 months with an AS-14404 clause. We note the movement in your offer.

On your volume question: our enquiry is for a binding 23,700 kg per year, DAP, 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01, with no tooling. That is the volume we commit to. We are not asking you to price on a forecast, so no historical consumption data is needed to assess it.

Your sales director has told us that Werdenfels is focusing on customers with volume (doc:20260916-70740-M5). We are therefore prepared to extend our commitment to 36 months, but only within one of the packages below.

Your offer combines the 14-day payment and 0 % deadband from our package C with a price well above that package's EUR 4.94. Those terms were offered only together with that price. That combination is therefore not agreed and is not part of this proposal.

We propose two alternative packages. Both are for 36 months with an index clause on AS-14404, material share 45 %, base month 2026-08. They are approximately equivalent for us after rounding:

A: EUR 5.25 per kg, payment 90 days net, 5 % deadband.
B: EUR 5.18 per kg, payment 30 days net, 5 % deadband.

Each price, payment term, clause and contract term is one indivisible conditional package. The third year and the faster payment in B apply only with that package price.

Your key account manager explained that price changes above 2 % need the approval of your pricing committee (doc:20260812-70740-M3). Please put both complete packages to the authorized pricing decision-maker now and return an improved, approved offer in writing. A call is not necessary.

Which complete package can the authorized pricing decision-maker approve, or which priced term prevents approval?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke
